title: Complete Cloud Migration to Business Central Online

facts.text: Open Cloud Migration Management page and select Migrate record links and notes after final data replication to transfer them from buffer table to actual record link table.
Go to Cloud Migration Management page, select Complete migration, read Cloud Ready Checklist, confirm understanding, then select Disable Cloud Migration.
SUPER permission set required to disable cloud migration.
Integration runtime remains installed on-premises but cloud registration auto-cleans after two weeks without use.
Create Microsoft 365 accounts with Business Central licenses for each on-premises user needing online access.
Open Define User Mappings page, match on-premises user accounts to online accounts in Cloud User field, then select OK to start update.
User mapping renames online account User Name to on-premises user name and updates dependent data via User codeunit RenameUser procedure.
Reconfigure Dynamics 365 Sales connection and re-establish connections to external services, APIs, Power Platform flows, and third-party integrations.
